CHATGPT User Reviews

Summary

Amount of texts per category

Histogram displaying the amount of text that belong to each category.

Amount of words per category

Boxplot showing the amount of words each text in a category have.

Umap reviews

A UMAP to see how similar the text of each category are.

Color by:



Word cloud

Most frequent words across all texts

Global Topic Counts

Barplot displaying how many times a topic appears.

Intertopic distance map

A Umap visualization generated in a way very similar to LDAvis.

The clusters are based on the embeddings from the embedding model, or in other words, they are determined by the semantic meaning of the words in each topic rather than what is explicitly written in them.

Hierarchcial clustering

A graph displaying the potential hierarchy of topics.

It uses c-TF-IDF representations for computing the similarities between topics, or in other words, the similarity between topics is determined by the words explicitly written in them.

Topic Word Score

c-TF-IDF scores of each topic, you can visualize the most meaningfull words for each of the topics.

Similarity Matrix

A heatmap showing how similar the topics are between them.
